authorization.approved_resources: One CPU thread, CPU FP32, three workloads and seeds, shared backbone pretraining followed by three sampler-only rounds. Existing dependencies/data plus local synthetic generation.
authorization.user_approval_reference: Current chat: user requested optimizing sampling per use-case iteratively after benchmarking, explicitly by gradient descent. This authorizes the bounded local follow-up; no recursive inference controller, cloud spending or endless research loop.

synthetic.tasks: Four random key/value bindings queried once; four-operand addition modulo 8. Generated examples are benchmark fixtures, not routing heuristics.

data.research_wide_region_reuse_audit: Text confirmation starts at 1020494, immediately after previous pilot scored prefix ended (1003854 + 256*65). Selection/tuning text was used by prior pilot training, disclosed; current backbone is fresh and only sees its own train region. No prior checkpoint transfer. Synthetic exact prompts are disjoint across all four splits; substrings/compositional elements may repeat. Public corpus familiarity and single-domain limits remain.

split_boundaries.evaluation: First 128 selection /256 confirmation examples; text uses nonoverlapping 65-byte chunks, 64 next-byte targets; synthetic one answer target per prompt.

data.teacher_and_objective: No teacher. Balanced task updates: mean CE per task batch. Text all bytes scored; synthetic only single answer byte. Padding/answer are never scored as inputs to the answer prediction.

decision.next_experiment: Choose from measured gradients and validation trajectories; no automatic new run after this budget.
decision.reason: No corpus/model training before protocol freeze; synthetic mechanical canary only

deployment.latency_statistics: p50 and nearest-rank p95, shared host load caveat
deployment.memory_components: Weight bytes and controller count; total process/device memory unmeasured here, no memory advantage claim
deployment.prefill_decode_protocol: Full forward median and p95 on a selection prompt per case. Decode not benchmarked in this follow-up.

design.compute_accounting: Full-shape measured profile in PROFILE.json; actual parent CPU/wall and fixed forward timings. No FLOP/parameter-matched cross-architecture claim.
design.control_rationale: Every sampler is initialized uniformly from the same frozen seed backbone. Shared controller receives 200 updates per workload per round; each specialized controller receives 200 updates on its workload. Same per-workload batches. Shared checkpoint selected by macro-average selection CE; specialized by own workload CE. Three specialized policies use three times the total router storage but equal active per-request router size. Dense/nanoGPT are not rerun because this experiment isolates sampling on the same backbone. Prior study remains separate.
design.learning_rate_trials_per_arm: One initial LR; three rounds. ReduceLROnPlateau halves LR after no selection improvement using fixed threshold. Every round plus initial checkpoint is retained and eligible; equal four selection opportunities.
design.matching_track: Same backbone, active dimensions and four executed blocks; equal per-workload tuning examples and target exposure. Shared and per-use-case storage/training aggregate are explicitly distinguished.
design.mechanism_equations: Unchanged prior SampledCurve cubic W(t) with four ordered depth positions and fixed endpoints. Backbone learned on task-balanced mixed data, then frozen. Only router coefficients receive Adam gradients. Global mode supplies no token features. Workload-specific routers are selected by explicit caller workload identity; no keyword routing rules.

evaluation.duplicate_policy: Two exact evaluations plus independent replay of all 36 endpoint rows

learning_qualification.synthetic: Every seed final selection accuracy >=22.5%, versus 12.5% answer-class chance. Failure means unlearned task; cannot promote sampler mechanism even if CE moves.
learning_qualification.text: Every seed final selection CE improves at least 10% from initialization

evaluation.multiple_comparison_policy: Three primary per-use-case specialization comparisons; success also requires uniform baseline. Global control required for token-dependence claim. Raw differences reported even if gate fails.
evaluation.primary_endpoint: All selected policies plus frozen baseline on fresh reserved confirmation, each workload separately
evaluation.uncertainty_method: Three paired seeds, t intervals df2; familywise alpha=.05 across three use cases by Bonferroni. Small sample normality unverified; intervals only cover seed variability on shared holdout.

evidence.preservation_policy: Exclusive-created outputs; preserve all base and every round optimizer/controller checkpoint, selected and rejected; no repeat on confirmation
evidence.protocol_sha256: Recorded externally in source manifest and registry

execution.canary_matrix: CANARY.json: nonconstant curve, nonzero router, causal logits/positions, positive ordered increments, gradients only on sampler, one optimizer step changes sampler but not base. All synthetic labels independently validated.
execution.source_ownership_and_concurrent_writers: Reuse dedicated SSD branch of prior draft PR; old evidence stays immutable. No matching run process. Child TMPDIR on SSD; Python -B.

experiment_id: Gradient descent on workload-specific sampling with frozen backbone
futility_rule: Stop for nonfinite loss/gradient, source/data drift, backbone mutation during sampling, unavailable SSD, resource/preservation failure or revoked permission. Always complete declared rounds if otherwise valid; no tuning from confirmation.
hypothesis: A token-dependent sampler tuned separately for each workload improves reserved loss relative to the frozen uniform baseline and a shared sampler given equal per-workload tuning exposure.
primary_comparator: Per-use-case token sampler versus shared token sampler; frozen uniform baseline and per-use-case global positions are mandatory controls.
primary_metric: Separate per-use-case reserved CE: nats/byte for text; nats/answer for synthetic tasks. Never pool reported endpoint losses.
success_rule: Per workload: all three paired CE gaps negative, mean <= -0.02, Bonferroni-across-three-workloads paired-t interval upper <0. Specialization support requires both shared and uniform comparisons; token-conditioning support also requires global comparison. Backbone learning qualification must pass before any mechanism promotion.

training.checkpoint_selection_rule: Backbone final only. Router lowest selection loss among rounds 0-3; ties retain earlier. Shared router selected once by mean of per-task selection losses; never choose a different shared checkpoint per task.
training.document_reset_policy: Independent examples; right padding for synthetic tasks excluded from loss

optimizer_schedule.backbone: AdamW constant LR, config betas/eps/weight decay; gradients clipped
optimizer_schedule.sampling: Adam on router only; config LR/betas/eps, gradient clip; ReduceLROnPlateau by selection between rounds; no weight decay

training.precision: CPU FP32; finite difference canary FP64
training.tokens_per_update: 512 input slots; 512 text targets or eight synthetic answer targets
